answer.answer: An experienced worker can obtain formal recognition for skills learned outside a training course through the Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 - Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) scheme [E01]. The process involves: (1) registering on the Skill India Digital platform [E03], (2) undergoing pre-screening by certified trainers to assess existing skills at no cost [E01][E03], (3) completing mandatory orientation/training of minimum 30 hours [E01], and (4) undergoing assessment and certification by NCVET-approved Awarding Bodies [E01]. Upon passing with 70% or higher marks, candidates receive an industry-relevant graded Skill Certificate [E02], along with one-year accidental insurance and a T-shirt [E01].

claim_to_evidence.claim: RPL scheme certifies candidates with prior learning experience or skills
Pre-screening is conducted at no cost to assess existing skills
Minimum 30 hours of mandatory orientation/training is required
Assessment and certification is conducted by NCVET-approved Awarding Bodies
Candidates receive a graded Skill Certificate upon passing with 70% or higher marks
Candidates receive one-year accidental insurance and a T-shirt
